title: Not Currently Available
summary: Amar has one final burial to arrange: his own. Help him mark the death of the man he was, then let him decide whether the grave needs an occupant.
offer_intro_line: Amar has already measured the ground. Of course he has.

offer_dialogue_steps.choice: I thought you said the grave was not meant to hold you.
offer_dialogue_steps.line: Correct. A grave can mark a death without becoming storage.
The account. The expectation. The part of me that has spent a century waiting for someone to notice the undertaker also died.
Stone around the cut, a proper marker, one light, and enough sand to close what we do not intend to fill.
I am an undertaker. Improvised burial is how this entire problem began.

objectives.completion_dialogue_line: Good. Straight edges, stable marker, no exposed void. I would have accepted this work from an apprentice.
Ten seconds pass. Amar remains standing beside the grave.

return_dialogue_line: There. It is a respectable grave. Irritatingly empty.

return_dialogue_steps.choice: Are you going to lie down?

return_dialogue_steps.line: I find that I do not want to.

return_dialogue_steps.choice: What will you put on the marker?

return_dialogue_steps.line: I have spent a very long time making certain the dead do not travel alone. It may be time I extend the courtesy to the living.
Very well. But if you die somewhere inaccessible, I reserve the right to be annoyed.

reward_dialogue_line: The ledger is closed. The grave is marked. I am, against expectation, still employed.
already_completed_line: The grave remains empty. I check occasionally. Professional habit.
